contradicting_evidence: Weak current breadth, negative mid/small-alt proxy medians and ETH-relative deterioration provide a plausible downside bias if they persist.
BTC's positive 24h return, positive latest supplied BTC ETF session and modest 30d stablecoin growth provide an upside alternative if sustained demand and wider participation emerge.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: No supported weekly trend can be selected from this snapshot. BTC-led stabilization could persist without alt recovery, while either broader expansion or renewed contraction remains conditional on subsequent price, relative-strength, breadth and demand evidence. NO_EDGE does not imply a flat market.
falsification_conditions: A sustained multi-session recovery in BTC and ETH with stronger ETH/BTC, widening participation and improving settled demand would establish an upward edge and replace NO_EDGE.
A sustained failure of recovery across BTC and ETH with persistent relative weakness, contracting participation and continued demand deterioration would establish a downward edge and replace NO_EDGE.
missing_evidence: A subsequent multi-session price and participation sequence sufficient to distinguish recovery from repeated retests.
Updated settled ETF flows, liquidity deployment evidence and comparable weekly positioning observations.
Current macro developments and validated catalysts capable of influencing the coming week.
supporting_evidence: The available fast evidence is mostly one completed hour and short microstructure samples; it cannot establish a seven-day trend.
